Reference usage:
<Picture 1> is the primary storyboard, brand-tone, character-style, product-style and shot-language reference.
Do not treat <Picture 1> as a literal static collage. Use it as a creative storyboard reference for a single short brand TVC video.

integrated_multimodal_description:

One continuous 5-second youthful beauty-brand TVC shot inspired by the storyboard in <Picture 1>.

Preserve the same overall tone from <Picture 1>: bright summer atmosphere, orange-and-white brand palette, energetic young woman, glossy beauty-commercial lighting, cheerful lifestyle mood, and a fresh social-media-friendly aesthetic. The heroine is a stylish young East Asian woman with long dark hair in a lively half-up hairstyle, wearing a bright orange sleeveless top with a youthful, sweet, confident image. The key product is a pink-orange beauty spray bottle labeled “MUSE POP”.

0.00-1.40 seconds:
Begin with a close-up of the heroine turning toward camera in bright sunlight, smiling with vivid, sparkling eyes. She lifts a white-and-orange megaphone beside her face and gives an energetic, playful expression, as if calling out to the world. Her hair and loose strands move lightly in the breeze.

1.40-3.30 seconds:
The camera pulls slightly wider into a lively medium shot. She lowers the megaphone, steps forward naturally, and raises the “MUSE POP” spray bottle toward camera with a bright confident smile. Her body language is open and dynamic, full of youthful energy, like a fashionable beauty commercial.

3.30-5.00 seconds:
Move into a clean product-emphasis beauty shot. She lightly sprays near her cheek, then closes her eyes briefly and tilts her face into the sunlight, enjoying the refreshing feeling. End on a polished hero composition with the product clearly visible near her face, her expression relaxed, radiant and confident.

Camera:
Use polished commercial shot language with one smooth flowing camera move. Start in a close-up, gently widen to a medium shot, then ease into a product-focused beauty framing. Motion should feel elegant, light and ad-like. No violent camera shake, no chaotic handheld movement.

Visual style:
Highly polished beauty TVC, glossy but natural skin, soft sunlight, clean highlights, fresh orange-white palette, premium cosmetic advertising style, youthful social-media commercial look, bright and pleasant atmosphere, subtle lens bloom, attractive product visibility, refined details.

Performance:
The heroine should feel lively, sweet, confident and natural. Expressions must be bright and appealing, but not exaggerated. Movements should be graceful, energetic and physically believable.

Avoid:
dark cinematic mood, sad emotion, cluttered background, low-energy acting, ugly product distortion, unreadable product, stiff posing, extra characters, scene cut to unrelated location, horror tone, heavy motion blur, broken hands, deformed face.
